name: Miguel Ángel Berbel
intro: I am a mathematician at Universidad Pontificia Comillas, working in geometric mechanics and classical field theory.
about: I use differential geometry to study how symmetry simplifies mechanical and field-theoretic systems, and how solutions of the original problem can be reconstructed from the reduced description.
interests: My research focuses on reduction by stages, the Lagrange–Poincaré and Poisson–Poincaré formalisms, and the geometry of principal and affine bundles. I am particularly interested in how different types of symmetry interact in the Lagrangian and Hamiltonian descriptions of field theory.
